name: Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce
author: Plugincy

sections.description:
Transform your WooCommerce store’s browsing experience with lightning-fast, real-time product filtering — no reloads, no delays, just smooth shopping.

Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce is a powerful, flexible, and developer-friendly plugin that allows customers to instantly filter products by attributes, price, category, rating, stock status, and even custom fields — all without reloading the page. Designed with performance, SEO, and usability in mind, it helps shoppers find the right products faster, increases engagement, and boosts conversions.

Whether you’re running a large online catalog, a niche store, or a complex WooCommerce setup, this plugin gives you full control over how filters look, behave, and appear across your site.

» Buy Pro | » More info | » Demos | » Docs

🎯 Core Filtering Features:

Core filtering features in this Ajax Product Filter for WooCommerce allow customers to narrow down products instantly using real-time AJAX technology. From price and rating to size, tags, stock status, and custom fields, users can apply multiple filters without reloading the page for a faster, smoother shopping experience.

✅️ Supercharged AJAX Filtering Engine

Powered by advanced AJAX technology, this solution ensures users receive instant updates to product listings as they apply filters. No more full-page reloads — just fast, fluid filtering that delivers a seamless experience.

  • Real-time results with every click or selection
  • Smooth pagination and sorting without page refresh or reload
  • Custom loader effects for a consistent brand experience

✅️ Powerful Filter Options – From Basic to Advanced

Help customers narrow down results using both the most common and the most advanced product filters available:

  • Product Basics Filters
    Helps users quickly find the right products based on common shopping needs:
  • Filter by Price
  • Filter by Rating
  • Filter by Category, Tags, Attributes (like size, color, material)
  • Keyword-based Search Filter
  • Product Metadata & Custom Field Filters
    Filters based on product metadata and unique identifiers:
  • Filter by Brand
  • Filter by Author
  • Filter by SKU
  • Filter by Custom Meta Fields
  • Stock & Availability Filters
    Useful for filtering by availability, promotional offers, and active deals:
  • Filter by Stock Status (In Stock, Out of Stock, etc.)
  • Filter by Sale Status
  • Filter by Discount Percentage
  • Product Dimensions & Weight Filters
    Filters based on specific, measurable product attributes:
  • Filter by Length, Width, Height
  • Filter by Weight
  • Date-Based Filters
    Allows users to discover products based on their published or availability date::
  • Today, This Week, This Month, This Year
  • Specific Date Range (From — To)

✅️ Multiple URL & AJAX-Based Filtering Methods

Our WooCommerce Ajax Product Filter Plugin supports a wide range of filtering formats, ensuring maximum flexibility for developers and a seamless UX for customers:

1. Query string-based filters

  • Format: ?filters=brand,size,color
  • Example: ?filters=adidas,l,blue

2. Query String Filtering with Key Prefixes

  • Format: ?filters=1&brand=adidas&size=l&color=blue

3. Clean Permalink-Based Filtering

  • Format: /filters/brand/size/color
  • Example: /filters/adidas/large/blue

4. Permalink Filtering with Key-Value Pairs

  • Format: /filters/brand=adidas/size=l/color=blue

5. AJAX-Based Filtering (No URL Change)

  • Dynamic filtering via AJAX requests without modifying the URL — ideal for SPAs and enhanced performance.

6. Real-Time Dynamic AJAX Filters

  • Instant filtering as users select options, with no page reloads and real-time product updates.

✅️ Full Widget & Shortcode Support

Available Shortcodes
Easily add filters anywhere on your site using simple shortcodes:

  • [plugincy_filters] – Complete filter set
  • [plugincy_filters_single name=”attribute_slug”] – Single button-style filter
  • [plugincy_filters_selected] – Display active filters (chips) widget

Built-in Dynamic AJAX Filter Widget & Block
Includes support for Elementor and the Block Editor, offering advanced customization options for greater design flexibility.

✅️ Mobile-Friendly & Responsive by Design

Optimized for users on the go:

  • Choose from 4 mobile friendly layouts:
    • Top View, Collapsible, Drawer, and iOS-style
  • Touch-friendly controls for better mobile filtering experience
  • Smooth transitions and easy navigation on all devices

✅️ Built-in SEO Optimization

Unlike many AJAX-based plugins, AJAX Product Filters by Plugincy is built with SEO in mind:

  • Create SEO-friendly, crawlable permalinks enriched with relevant keywords
  • Customize SEO titles, meta descriptions, and metadata for filtered pages
  • Enable anchor-based navigation for SEO-friendly filtering and improved accessibility
  • Use optional AJAX-only mode when SEO is not required (e.g., single-page applications)

🎨 Advanced Filter Design & UI:

Create a sleek, modern, and fully customizable filtering interface that enhances user experience and matches your store’s design perfectly.

  • Multiple UI Elements
    Offer dynamic and flexible filtering through a variety of interface options:

    • Dropdowns
    • Checkboxes
    • Radio Buttons
    • Sliders
    • Color Swatches
    • Images
    • Button Check
    • Input Fields
    • Advanced Rating System

  • Upgraded Dropdowns with Select2
    Boost filter usability with advanced, searchable, and stylized dropdowns for a smoother and more intuitive user experience.

  • New Filter Styles
    Modern, user-friendly filter designs that adapt seamlessly to your store’s look and enhance the overall shopping experience.

  • Collapsible Widget Options
    Keep your filter area clean and organized by grouping long lists into expandable and collapsible sections for easier navigation.

  • Customizable Filter Widgets via Elementor & Gutenberg
    Easily manage filter widget order, visibility, and styling directly within Elementor or the WordPress Block Editor—no coding needed. Enjoy full visual control over your filter layout and design.

  • Filter Visibility Control
    Choose where and how filters appear — globally or per page, giving you full control over filter placement.

  • Different Filters for Different Pages
    Assign unique filter sets to specific pages, categories, or product types for a more targeted user experience.

  • Customizable Loader
    Choose from 6 built-in loading effects, or create your own using custom HTML and CSS for a personalized experience

⚡ Compatibility & Performance:

Deliver blazing-fast filtering without sacrificing compatibility. This plugin is optimized for speed, SEO, and seamless integration with any modern WooCommerce setup.

  • Speed Optimized
    Designed for high performance — delivers faster filtering than most plugins in its class, ensuring a smooth shopping experience.

  • Works with Custom & Premium Themes
    Seamlessly integrates with any WooCommerce-compatible theme, whether free, custom-built, or premium.

  • Built-in WordPress Widget Support
    Easily add filters to sidebars, footers, or any widget-ready area for flexible placement across your store.

  • Search by Text Field
    Enable users to refine results by entering keywords directly into a search field within the filter panel.

🔓 Pro Features – Unlock the Full Power:

Upgrade to Pro for advanced filtering power and enterprise-ready features:

  • Dynamic Filtering with SEO-Friendly Permalinks
    Use clean, customizable URLs (e.g., /brand/nike/color/black) to improve search engine indexing and deliver a better user experience.

  • Anchor-Based Navigation
    Use anchor links instead of select elements for better indexing and accessibility.

  • Unlimited Filters
    Create and combine unlimited filter options with full customization to match any store layout or product catalog.

  • Dynamic Rating Display
    Show product ratings with modern, theme-adaptive designs that enhance visual consistency and user experience.

  • Advanced Price Sliders
    Offer smooth, fully customizable price range sliders with real-time filtering for precise and user-friendly control.

  • Separate Subcategory Widgets
    Display and filter subcategories separately to improve navigation and enhance the user experience.

  • Import & Export Settings
    Easily transfer plugin configurations between sites for faster setup and consistent filtering experiences.

  • Premium Feature Updates
    Enjoy continuous access to new premium features and improvements as part of your Pro upgrade—no extra fees, always up to date.

  • Widget Caching
    Boost site performance by caching resource-intensive filter widgets, reducing load times and server usage.

❤️ Why Store Owners Love It

  • Instant AJAX filtering that boosts UX and reduces friction
  • Flexible filtering controls that adapt to any store type
  • Built-in mobile styles for a great experience on all devices
  • SEO-ready with beautiful URLs and crawlable filter pages
  • Compatible with all themes and builders

🛍️ Perfect For:

  • Multi-category mega stores (assign unique filters per category
  • Fashion Stores (filter by color, size, brand)
  • Electronics & Gadgets (filter by specs, price, ratings)

  • and many more

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard:

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce”
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page
  4. Configure filter settings in the WooCommerce settings panel under “Product Filters.”

Process of Using AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce Store

Step 1: Configure Product Filters
1. Navigate to Admin → Product Filters → Form Manage.
2. Enable the options for Show Categories, Show Attributes, Show Tags, Show Price Range, and Show Rating as needed.
3. Choose a filtering method in the use URL-Based Filter section:
– With Query String (e.g., ?filters)
– With Permalinks
– With Ajax

Step 2: Add Products and Customize Filters
1. Add WooCommerce products, categories, attributes, and tags.
2. Use the [plugincy_filters] shortcode to display filtering options wherever needed.
3. Customize the filter widget styles via Admin → Product Filters → Form Style tab.

Recommended Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.0 or higher
sections.faq:
Is This Plugin Compatible With My Theme?

Yes! Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce is compatible with most WordPress themes, including custom and premium themes.

How Can I Configure the Filter Options?

Simply go to the WordPress admin, locate the “Product Filters” section, and customize the filter options based on your store requirements.

Does the Plugin Support Custom Permalinks?

Yes, the plugin supports custom permalink structures, allowing filtered pages to align with your store’s permalink setup.

Is the Plugin Compatible With Product Variables?

Yes, Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce plugin is fully compatible with product variables, allowing smooth filtering based on variations like size, color, and other attributes.

Does This Plugin Support Shortcode Usage?

Yes, you can use the following Shortcode to place filters anywhere on your site.
[plugincy_filters attribute=”your-attribute” terms=”your-terms1, your-terms2″ category=”yourcata1, your-cata2″ tag=”your-tag1, your-tag2″], [plugincy_filters_single name=”your_selector”] shortcode to place filters anywhere on your site.
